caption:
Green snot at 6 am does not automatically mean a sick day.

The AAP says a cough or runny nose without fever usually isn't a reason to keep a little one home. What matters more: a fever plus acting sick, vomiting twice in a day, or a kid who just can't join in.

After a fever, wait 24 hours fever-free without medicine before sending them back.

And line up your sick-day backup now. November is coming for all of us.
